name: infobox-recommender
title: Infobox Recommender
subtitle: Peer-census evidence for whether an article should have an infobox — and which template
description: For an English Wikipedia article that has no infobox, infobox-recommender discovers the article's peers (Wikidata P31 class siblings, same-type pointers such as position held, part of the series, part of and preceded/succeeded by, and the article's most specific categories), censuses which infoboxes those peers actually use, and reports the recommended template together with its evidence: peer count, coverage, the template distribution, neighbourhood tiers and example peers. It abstains when the evidence is mixed, and it never edits articles. Evaluated on an 88-case labelled corpus: 57 pass, 6 near-miss or defensible disagreements, 25 abstentions — 90% accuracy on decisive verdicts.
keywords: wikipedia, infobox, templates, wikidata, consensus, peer comparison, citation needed
